2.en: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

3.en: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].

4.en: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

5.en: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

8.en: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

9.en: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

11.en: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]

13.en: A [large] company of the former peoples

14.en: And a few of the later peoples,

16.en: Reclining on them, facing each other.

17.en: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal

18.en: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -

19.en: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -

20.en: And fruit of what they select

21.en: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.

22.en: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,

24.en: As reward for what they used to do.

25.ar: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
25.en: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -

27.en: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

28.en: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed

35.en: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation

37.en: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,

38.en: For the companions of the right [who are]

39.en: A company of the former peoples

40.en: And a company of the later peoples.

41.en: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

42.en: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

43.en: And a shade of black smoke,

45.en: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,

46.en: And they used to persist in the great violation,

47.ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
47.en: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

49.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples

50.en: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."

51.en: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,

52.en: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum

53.en: And filling with it your bellies

54.en: And drinking on top of it from scalding water

55.en: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.

56.en: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.

57.en: We have created you, so why do you not believe?

58.en: Have you seen that which you emit?

59.en: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?

60.ar: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
60.en: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone

61.ar: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَـٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
61.en: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.

62.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
62.en: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?

63.en: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?

64.en: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?

65.ar: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ حُطَـٰمًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ
65.en: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,

68.en: And have you seen the water that you drink?

69.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ
69.en: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?

70.ar: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ أُجَاجًا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ
70.en: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?

71.en: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?

72.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ
72.en: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?

73.en: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,

74.en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

75.en: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,

76.en: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.

77.en: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an

79.en: None touch it except the purified.

80.en: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

81.en: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent

82.en: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?

83.en: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat

84.en: And you are at that time looking on -

85.ar: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ
85.en: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -

86.en: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,

87.en: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?

88.en: And if the deceased was of those brought near to Allah,

89.en: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.

90.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
90.en: And if he was of the companions of the right,

91.en: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."

92.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
92.en: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,

93.en: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water

95.en: Indeed, this is the true certainty,

96.en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
